units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13b:2">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>עשייה דידה מ׳ היא</he> its preparation consists in washing (the writing) off (<cite ref="Numbers 5:23">Num. V, 23</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 2:4:2">Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>למ׳ ניתנה</he> is intended to be blotted out. Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:54">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מאי מ׳ היתה וכ׳</he> what scraping was done in the preparation of the Tabernacle?
